title: In the matter of Liquidity Technologies Ltd — reorganisation application
notes: Primary court judgment records the proposed creditor treatment at the application stage: creditor-balance haircuts, dollarisation, pro-rata rvUSD rights tied to recoveries from the Roger Ver claim, pro-rata CoinFLEX equity rights and FLEX distributions, with 75% creditor approval and later final court approval still required. This source does not establish that the proposal was finally approved or that any creditor ultimately received a particular recovery percentage.
